digest.component_or_area: Python module organization and complexity metrics
propositions: 46 of 435 Python files in src/rebar exceed 700 LOC; 7 files are at or within 2 lines of the hard 800 LOC cap, creating exhausted module-size headroom.
Pass1.py (800 LOC) container pairing logic, push.py (800 LOC) recovery cluster, and completion_banking.py (799 LOC) require extraction into new modules to restore headroom below 550 LOC each.

The near-cap leading indicator (module_size_distribution.near_cap_count reporting 37 files within 10% of the 800 LOC cap) was computed but invisible until wired into CI as a non-blocking warning pass in the Module-size gate.
The existing module_size_distribution.near_cap_count indicator depends on code_health.size_cap being configured, so will report null for projects that do not set the cap.

Three module splits landed via Gerrit (1751/1752/1753) with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, reaching final LOC: pass1.py 534, container_stage.py 296, generation.py 362, push.py 524, push_recovery.py 366.
